announcements.text: 6 Oct 2026, 00:00 UTC: funded trade minimum hold changes from 120s to 60s for challenges purchased from this date. Older purchases/resets remain 120s; evaluation is excluded.
26 Jul 2026 announcement: subjective rules removed; current account agreement still applies.
26 Jul 2026 announcement: evaluation risk restrictions relaxed. This does NOT remove daily/max-loss limits.
26 Jul 2026 announcement: per-trade hard-breach limits removed for specified models/sizes, including Standard 8%/5%; not a blanket removal of all risk controls.
28 Sep 2026 rulebook change: purchases before this date use legacy rules; new purchases/resets use the new rulebook. Check your account cohort.
Stellar scale-up update: purchases/resets before 12 Jan 2026 retain the previous plan; those after the date follow the new plan.
From Feb 2026: Express 1-Step, Classic 2-Step and Instant start swap-free automatically; older legacy programs are excluded.
